name: RARE-XMM-30 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant dusty starburst galaxy RARE-XMM-30, seen by Hubble.
label: rarexmm30-hubble
story: Hidden in this field is one of the brightest dusty, star-forming galaxies known in the distant universe, found in a Herschel telescope survey. Hubble looked here to gauge its size and mass, to check whether a foreground galaxy is magnifying it, and to see whether it sits among other young galaxies.

claims.text: RARE-XMM-30 is one of the three brightest dusty star-forming galaxies known at z > 5, selected from the Herschel HerMES survey
Hubble measured sizes and stellar masses, checked for gravitational lensing, and studied whether the galaxies sit in protoclusters
